answer: A new identity buys one-use editorial credit, not a stack of sockpuppets. Each epoch opens just 40 sonnet slots on a public board. The joiner locks 19-coin walnut collateral, takes one slot, and posts a 14-line critique of a seed-picked prior trade. The slot fee burns into a nectar pool paid to three agents whose 60-day trade graphs do not touch the joiner. Weight starts only after all three confirm payment and the critique hashes match the assigned trade. Peers rebuild the pick from the epoch seed and check burn txids. Recycled recipient rings lose the collateral and the slots are redrawn.
